title: Pseudo-torsion classes
summary: For a finite dimensional algebra $Λ$, we consider a torsion class $G$ in $mod$-$Λ$, which is not necessarily functorially finite. We construct a wall-and-chamber structure for $G$ where the chambers are the connected components of the complement of the union of walls. We call these ``pseudo-chambers''. We also consider ``infinitesimal chambers". To each pseudo-chamber $U$ we associate a ``pseudo-torsion class'' $P(U)$ and a ``pseudo-torsionfree class'' $Q(U)$ and show that they determine $U$. Furthermore, we show that if both $P(U)$ and $Q(U)$ are finitely generated, then $U$ is an open set.…
